content: Sekem imogheer pa Dina
Sawa eez, Yakop yesuru Lea natudi liva Dina ila ighaze ighita ndiliva papaghu pida to ndug Sekem.
Amor to daba to ndug tonowen, natu Sekem ighita Dina, ve ila isavagi ve imogheer pani. Amor, ye Hep taamdi.
Sekem lolo pa Dina kat. Tovenen isavia saveeŋ popoia pida pani, leso irab ate, ve ighami lolo poia.
Ve isaav pa tama Amor ighaze: “Tamaŋ, you lolog pa liva paghu tonowen kat. Ula to siŋ toni, ve yamŋa agharaat saveeŋ leso navaii.”

Yakop ilooŋ ŋgar mayaŋiiŋa to Sekem igham pa natu liva, eemoghon isavia saveeŋ eta rikia maau. Pasa, ndinatu nditamoot tila ndug ite ve tigham uraat pa ŋginiiŋ ŋgai toni tonowe. Tovenen itatan tau ve inaam di.
Ye inamnaam di ve inepneep, ve Sekem tama Amor ila ivot toni ighaze yesuru tigharaat saveeŋ.

Yakop ndinatu tilooŋ ŋgar samia to Sekem igham pa livudi, ve timuul tinim tivot paanu. Lolodi poia maau. Atedi yabyab kat. Pasa, lolodi pa ŋgar tovene ivot padi malep. Tighita tighaze Sekem igham mayaŋiiŋa tiina pa yes Israela.
Amor isaav padi ighaze: “Alooŋ. Natug Sekem, ye lolo pa natum liva kat ve itaŋ pani ighaze ivaii. Vena, irau ayok pani ve ivai natug?
You naghita naghaze nene poia pa papaghu toit tiwavain di. Yei pale nivai ndinatumim ndiliva, ve yam avai ndinatumai ndiliva.
Aghita. Taan tiina inepneep. Yam taumim aghita lemim taan pida pa aneep pani. Leso itiŋa talup ghiit, ve taparabol pa mbeb toit ila inim.”
Ghoro Sekem imundig ve isaav pa Dina tama Yakop toman ndilivu tovene: “Ighaze lolomim toman ŋgar tiam inim tiou, sa mbeb to lolomim pani, you pale nagham payam.
Tovenen asavia liva atia payou. Izi, ma iza, you pale nagham payam. Eemoghon ayok pa naghami inim azuwag.”
Eemoghon Yakop ndinatu atedi yabyab kat pa Sekem pa ŋgar mayaŋiiŋa to igham pa livudi Dina. Tovenen tigham kaarom pa Sekem yesuru tama Amor tighaze:
“Vana maau. Tamoot to ighaze tiziri maau, nene irau niyok pa ivai livumai maau. Pa vene, igham mayaŋiiŋa payei.
Ataam ee moghon to inepneep. Yam irau ataghon gabuamai, ve azir nditamoot tiam, le iit tasob rarateed, ghoro niyok pa saveeŋ tiam,
ve niyok pa itiŋa tawavain ghiit, ve nineep izi ndug tonene, ve talup ghiit tanim ee moghon.
Ve ighaze yam ayok pa zirooŋ gham maau, nene pale nilat nigham livumai, ve nighau nila.”

Amor yesuru natu Sekem tilooŋ saveeŋ todi, ve tiyok pani tighaze nene ŋgar poia. Tovenen rikia moghon, ve Sekem ipamundigin mbeb tonenen saveeŋa. Pasa, ye lolo pa Yakop natu liva kat. Sekem, siŋ to tama tisob titandag pani ve tiloŋlooŋ aliŋa.
Tovenen Amor yesuru natu Sekem tila pa ndug to lupuuŋ to igharau ataam avo ve tisaav pa yes nditamoot tisob to ndug Sekem tighaze:
“Ndiran tonowen, ndiran luuma, ve tighaze itiŋa talup ghiit tanim ee moghon. Iit taan toit tiina. Irau tapul pida padi. Leso tilaghlaagh pani, ve tiraukol pa mbeb todi, ve itiŋa irau tawavain ghiit.
Eemoghon yes tiyoon ariaŋa pa mbeb ee moghon tonene. Tighaze tazir ghiit tasob le rarateed tanimale yes, ghoro tiyok pa tineep toman ghiit, ve itiŋa talup ghiit tanim ee moghon.
Ighaze tataghon ŋgar todi, nene pale inim ataam pait ve tagham ŋgai todi to ghaniiŋ ve to uraat, toman mburuguuŋ todi tisob tinim leed. Yo, yam taumim asaav. Vena, tayok pa ŋgar todi, ma maau?”
Yes to paanu tilooŋ saveeŋ to Sekem yesuru tama Amor, ve tiyok. Tovenen tizir nditamoot todi tisob.

Uraat to zirooŋ di isob, ve mboŋ inim tol ve nditamoot to ndug Sekem tinepneep toman yabyabuuŋ tiina sone. Ghoro Yakop ndinatu ru, Simeon ve Levi to Dina ndilivu, timundig toman buza todi, ve tilooŋ tila ndug Sekem. Yes to paanu tikankaan pa ŋgar to yesuru tighaze tighami. Yesuru tila, ve timbut nditamoot tisob timatmaat.
Amor ve natu Sekem paam, timbut yesuru pa buza ve timaat. Ghoro tigham livudi Dina, ve tipul ruum to Sekem, ve tighau tila.

Ghoro Yakop ndinatu pida anadi timundig ve tilaan muri tilooŋ tila ndug Sekem, ve tiyou mbeb to yes to tirab di timaat ne, inim yatuuŋ ŋgar samia to tigham pa livudi Dina. Tigham makau, esele, ve sipsip todi, toman mbaliiŋ ve mbeb todi pida to tineep ruum lolo. Mbeb todi to ineep paanu, ve mbeb to uum paam, eta ineep muul maau. Tiyou di le tisob. Ve tiyou ndiliva todi toman ndinatudi paam.

Yes tigham ŋgar tonenen, le Yakop ate yabyab ve iyaan Simeon yesuru Levi ighaze: “Yamru awaghamun izag wa. Yes Kanaana ve Peresa to tinepneep izi taan tonene, pale tighita ghou tighaze you ŋgeu samiag kat, ve tighur koi payou. Ighaze tilup di ve tigham malmal pait, nene pale tirab ghiit tasob tamatmaat. Pasa, iit ival maau.”
Eemoghon yesuru tipamuul aliŋa tighaze: “Pale nipul ŋgeu tonowen igham tovene pa livumai inimale ye liva to ataam?”
